Warehouse order picker/HLO - Den Hoorn -  €15.29 per uur - Logistics - 36 hour Do you want to work as an HLO (Man Up) Orderpicker at the major logistics company Van der Helm? The job is performed using a tall Combi Truck. The worker sits inside the cabin of the machine. The cabin is large enough to provide the worker with space to sit and move safely.
